receipt_chain_naming_note: Receipt logging runs on Avalanche Fuji C-Chain (43113) or an explicitly configured Receipt Chain RPC; no custom Avalanche L1 claim is made without an active dedicated L1 RPC and explorer proof.

verified_flows: DEPOSITED -> RELEASED (pass releases exact amount once; settled proof rejected)
DEPOSITED -> REFUNDED_INVALID (fail refunds exact amount to payer)
DEPOSITED -> REFUNDED_TIMEOUT (timeout blocks processing and refunds payer via claimTimeoutRefund)

Adversarial rejections: empty/signature-only proof, fake txHash, wrong scheme/token/chain, changed date/corpus/tier, payer mismatch, forged context, insufficient confirmations, reorg detection, missing USDC Transfer, reverted tx
Unique deposit txHash enforcement across questionIds (409 DEPOSIT_TX_REUSED)
requestHash mismatch, tx conflict for questionId, and concurrent lease rejection (409 JOB_IN_PROGRESS)
Crash recovery at QA_PERSISTED and RECEIPT_RECORDED without duplicate recordReceipt
On-chain resolved state reconciliation and offline EIP-191 signature verification

avalanche_fuji_testnet_live.reason: Funded Avalanche Fuji payer and oracle wallets (test AVAX for gas + Fuji test USDC) are required to execute live transactions and record explorer URLs. No fabricated tx hashes are stored.
